text:
maria: ran nsys on a prod-like KV-heavy trace; seeing HBM bandwidth saturations coincident with KV cache churn and a ~12% p99 latency regression after last kernel-selection rollout. attaching perfetto + nsys snippets. pls advise.

josh: can you paste the nsys summary or perfetto link?

maria: perfetto: https://perfetto.dev/trace/abcd1234
nsys cmd: nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --output=traces/1769408400 --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi
summary: peak HBM bw 520 GB/s, sustained 420 GB/s spikes during kv-cache refill windows

kevin: what kernels are hot? kernel timeline?

maria: top kernels in the hotspot window:
- multihead_attn_fwd_fused_v2
- kv_cache_load_kernel
- kv_cache_evict_kernel
- split_gemm_qk_v1

nvprof shows kv_cache_* kernels multiple small launches per token, high DRAM traffic.

tara: sounds like cache thrash. Did kernel-selection change alter blocking/batching? last rollout switched to 'adaptive_small_batch' mode right?

maria: yes, commit d4f7a2c last wed changed selection to prefer fused attention kernels for short seqs; seems to cause more frequent KV flushes for long sequences because fused kernel uses different kv layout.

perf-bot: nsys quick report: window 12:34-12:45
- p50 latency +3%
- p95 latency +9%
- p99 latency +12%
- HBM avg bw 380 GB/s during spike

kevin: hypothesis: fused kernel writes KV differently (packed) causing misalignment for existing cache slices -> extra memcpy / partial fills -> HBM thrash. Could we steer kernel selection for seq_len > 1024 to the older kernel?

josh: can we reproduce locally with synthetic load? run:
```
python infra/bench/kv_bench.py --model r-infer-3B --seq 4096 --batch 8 --duration 120
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --output=trace4096
```

maria: ran synthetic earlier, confirmed repeated small kv_load kernels ~8000 launches/s during peak. Also saw a lot of cudaMemCpyAsync of 64B chunks.

tara: action items:
- kevin to add kernel-selection rule: prefer legacy_k_attn for seq>1024 (owner: kevin)
- josh to run microbench with patched selector and compare nsys timelines (owner: josh)
- maria to collect perfetto full trace and upload (owner: maria)
- infra to add perf regression test for kv-heavy large seq (owner: tara)

kevin: starting patch now, will push a canary to staging with selector flag --force-legacy-attn

maria: uploaded full perfetto: https://perfetto.dev/trace/efgh5678

josh: thanks. if selector fix drops HBM peak and reduces small memcpy launches, we ship rollback to kernel selection or add rule.

maria: adding logs: snippet of nvprof output:
```
GPU activities:
177.23ms  multihead_attn_fwd_fused_v2    40%  HBM write  ...
60.12ms   kv_cache_load_kernel           20%  small memcpy (64B) x many
```

perf-bot: created ticket INF-472 for tracking (https://jira/redwood/INF-472) :eyes:

josh: pinging infra for storage of large perf traces

infra-bot: allocated s3://redwood-perf/traces/1769408400/ (retention 90d)

maria: thanks all, will post follow-up after canary. :thumbsup:
